description: Look up a compound in SureChEMBL, EMBL-EBI's database of chemistry extracted from patents, by any identifier, and report its structure, properties, cross-references (ChEMBL, PubChem, DrugBank, ChEBI, PDB) and how many patents mention it.

identifier.description: A SureChEMBL id ("SCHEMBL1353" or "1353"), a ChEMBL id ("CHEMBL25"), a PubChem CID as "pubchem:2244", a DrugBank id as "drugbank:DB00945", a standard InChIKey, a SMILES, or a chemical name ("aspirin"; resolved through PubChem to a structure, since SureChEMBL has no name lookup).

name: surechembl_compound
title: Look up a patent compound
